description: A shell script for testing and interpreting exotic Git branch name arguments, including corner cases and special syntax like @{-1} and @{upstream}. It sets up a repository, performs branch operations, and verifies behaviors related to branch references and upstreams.

methods.name: expect_branch
methods.description: Verifies that the latest commit message of a branch matches an expected value.

methods.name: expect_deleted
methods.description: Checks that a given reference does not exist.
